listing.name: The Catacomb Apocalypse (CatacombGL)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native Windows/Linux port with desktop beta archives and explicit retail/shareware setup. Limits: Separate supported game identities; original Catacombs data required except allowed shareware route. Only The Catacomb Abyss has the documented free shareware 1.13 route. Descent, Armageddon and Apocalypse need owned Catacombs Pack data; do not apply shareware to all four targets. Upstream platforms: Native Windows7/8/10/11 and Linux beta archives/source builds, including RaspberryPi build instructions. Exact release CPU architectures unknown in frozen evidence. Original data: Own The Catacomb Apocalypse data from the Catacombs Pack, as required by CatacombGL. Catacomb Abyss v1.13 shareware is a different game and does not provide this target. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
